description: Read the current Nightbreak Forge local Lua validator/editor reference. Use this to see which hooks, fields, methods, exact values, and handle helpers the editor currently knows about. **Pass `script_type` matching the file you are working on:** `"lua-power"` (default, EliteMobs boss powers — includes context handles, `em`, and exact values), `"fmm-script"` (FMM props), or `"npc-script"` (EliteMobs NPC scripts in `npc_scripts/`), or `"mind-behavior"` (EliteMobs Mind AI programs in `behaviors/`, selected by a boss's `behavior` field), `"fmm-pet-behavior"` (FreeMinecraftModels pet behavior modules in `pet_behaviors/`, id `fmm:pet/<file name>`; loaded from FMM 2.13.0), or `"em-enchantment-script"` / `"fmm-enchantment-script"` (the Lua effect of an EliteMobs or FreeMinecraftModels enchantment in `enchantments/`). Each returns that script type's own hooks and `context.*` namespaces — the boss reference does NOT contain NPC, FMM, Mind or enchantment APIs, so query the matching type.

scope.description: Optional scope. For lua-power: "hooks", "context", "boss", "player", "event", "script", "handles", "em", or "values". For fmm-script/npc-script: "hooks", "context", or a context namespace name (e.g. "npc", "player", "prop", "projectile").

script_type.description: Which script type's reference to return. Defaults to "lua-power".

name: get_local_lua_reference
